topic.title: Rich vs poor: the same ₹1 lakh Diwali bonus, a festive sale or put to work for 15 years

cta: Rich move or poor move? Comment
title: Your Diwali bonus: rich vs poor 🪔
description:
Same ₹1 lakh Diwali bonus, two very different moves. Which one is yours?
One spends it in the festive sale, one puts it to work for 15 years at an assumed return. Speak to a licensed financial adviser in your country before making financial decisions.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
